text:
anna_support: Hey team, getting a bunch of reports that the Console filters for Region + Model+Version are not actually narrowing charts — customers select region=eu-west + redwood-rlhf-v2 but the usage graph still shows global traffic. Billing team is seeing mismatches. :eyes:

mike_prod: Can you paste repro steps? Is this only on the Usage -> Per-model page or everywhere?

anna_support: Repro I used: 1) Open Console -> Analytics -> Usage 2) Set Region: eu-west, Model: redwood-rlhf-v2, Version: v2.1 3) Click Apply 4) Charts still show total tokens across all regions. Happened in Chrome 114 and Safari. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/abc123

jess_eng: Noted. Any request id from the network tab? Also check whether the query sent to /api/analytics has params region=model/version or something else. Could be a telemetry key mismatch.

anna_support: Network tab shows request body: `{ "filters": { "region": "eu-west", "model": "redwood-rlhf-v2", "version": "v2.1" } }` Response has totals but breakdowns empty. No obvious 500.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: frontend@2025-10-21T14:02:11Z (sha: a1b2c3) | release notes: analytics/filter-refactor

elena_ops: digging — we rolled a change this morning that renamed `region` -> `locale` in the telemetry ingestion layer to support multi-locale. Looks like the analytics backend still expects `region`. If ingestion only writes `locale`, filters that use `region` will be no-ops.

jess_eng: OK that explains missing breakdowns. Quick mitigation: map both keys in the analytics query layer so we accept `region` OR `locale` while we patch ingestion. I'll open a hotfix PR to add fallback.

mike_prod: Please also add a short support note + CS workaround. What's the manual workaround we can give customers?

anna_support: Temp workaround: remove region filter and instead use model+version plus the per-region dropdown on the raw export; or query API directly with `locale` param. Example curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/internal/analytics/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"filters":{"locale":"eu-west","model":"redwood-rlhf-v2","version":"v2.1"}}'```

jess_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/p/redwood/analytics/merge_requests/789 — adds `region || locale` normalization. Will push to staging first.

elena_ops: I've flagged rollback if hotfix fails. Also creating incident record in PagerDuty for visibility.

mike_prod: Thanks. anna, pls paste impacted customer list (from support tickets) into the MR thread so eng can triage priority. Add any billing alerts.

anna_support: Will do. Adding ticket IDs: #4321 #4327 #4339. Marking this P1 for CS until hotfix is live. :fire:

jess_eng: Will monitor staging metrics after deploy and follow up here.
